controls.angle_flip: F8 / Flip Angle; independent of travel direction
controls.reverse_hz_definition: Direction changes per second in Farm Area; 0 uses distance. Timed span is derived from requested speed/frequency and capped by road length.

offline_checks.extreme_area_reflection: 0/45/90 degrees, normal/inverted, requested 10000 km/h; bounds and facing preserved
offline_checks.reverse_timer: 2 reversals/s over 10 seconds, bounded span; manual reverse and brake preserve position
offline_checks.standalone_ui: Farm angle editing and Flip Angle do not reverse travel; Farm/Cool/Area, stop, diagnostics and reinjection
offline_checks.cool_physics: Normal Cool ticks apply physical impulses / yaw assistance without model PivotTo; recovery retains pose solver
offline_checks.standalone_tunnel: Banked floor below roof/mountain layers; forward/reverse at 500 km/h
offline_checks.native_contact_scope: Original uploaded CarPhysics on mocked planes, +/-90 and backward zero orientation; 85/500/10000 km/h velocity targets. Not Roblox networking or actual collision solver.

original_controller_benchmark.test: Original CarPhysics / GarageConfig on planar fixture
original_controller_benchmark.limitations: Not Roblox, real 3D collision/suspension, networking, streaming or a live executor test

limitations: Extreme speed is a selectable/commanded target, not a promise that Roblox/server will sustain it.
Cool keeps normal vehicle physics and corner limits; it does not instantly reach the selected speed.
Visible reverse frequency is limited by update/render rate. Short roads cap timed sweep span, so position travel and commanded velocity can differ.
Four-wheel supported recovery requires loaded ground; server corrections/collisions can still interfere.
0 degrees does not qualify as a drift; the visible client angle bonus caps at 60 degrees; same-spot farming can pay less. No reward remotes are called.
